subject: Request: short trial top-up + 2-week extension — integration blocker
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@maplehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@maplehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Trial top-up request — blocked on auth change

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the onboarding call yesterday. We started switching our staging traffic over to Redwood yesterday afternoon and ran into an unexpected auth change in our middleware that prevents requests from reaching your inference endpoint. Our infra team is actively debugging but it looks like this will take a few more days to stabilize.

We are down to ~20% of our trial credits and have a product demo scheduled for a pilot sponsor on 2026-07-22. To avoid the demo being impacted while our engineering team finishes the patch, can Redwood provide: 1) a short 2-week trial extension, and 2) a one-time top-up of 150k token credits to keep our tests running through the demo?

I attached the staging logs and the integration plan our engineers put together to help your team triage. Happy to hop on a quick call — Tom and I are available tomorrow afternoon.

Appreciate any help you can provide here,

— Anita Rao
Product Manager, Integrations
Maple HealthTech

Attachments:
- integration-logs-20260708.zip (log archive)
- MAPLE-Integration-Plan.pdf (integration steps & timelines)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial top-up request — blocked on auth change

Hi Anita — thanks for the context and the attachments, I reviewed the logs briefly. Sorry to hear you hit this during the onboarding window.

Plan from our side: I can approve a 2-week extension to the trial and an initial 75k token top-up immediately to get you past the most urgent tests. We'll make the remainder of the top-up (to reach 150k total) contingent on a short engineering checkpoint: can Karthik confirm the ETA for the patch and whether any additional runtime changes are required on our end?

Rishi — can you please note this in the deal (DL-9451) and confirm the billing/credits flow so we can apply the extension and staged top-up? Monica — please standby to prepare a short one-pager we can share with the pilot sponsor if they ask about timeline.

If you want the full 150k up front, I can escalate to our sales lead, but I'd prefer to pair the increase with the engineering ETA so we minimize abuse and keep the pilot aligned.

Happy to jump on the call tomorrow if useful.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial top-up request — blocked on auth change

Hi all,

Thanks for the logs — I pulled them into a local run. The 401s are coming from a mismatch in the Authorization header formatting after your gateway added a short-lived token exchange step. Our runtime is expecting a standard Bearer token; the exchange wraps additional attributes in the header which causes our front proxy to reject the request.

Work plan and ETA: our engineering team can add a small compatibility shim in the front proxy to normalize the header within 48 hours (I estimate by end of day Sunday 2026-07-12 PDT). This doesn't require model changes. Once the shim is deployed we'll run a quick smoke test with your staging cluster and confirm.

Given that, Stephanie's proposed approach works for me: staged credits. If you need the full 150k up front for the demo on 2026-07-22, I can sign off but will ask the product team to keep an eye on usage.

Karthik
Staff Engineer — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie — thanks, that sounds fair and much appreciated. We'll take the staged approach: please apply the 2-week extension and the initial 75k token top-up now. Once Karthik confirms the shim is live, we'll ask for the remaining 75k.

Tom and I confirmed with our pilot sponsor that 2 weeks plus the extra 75k will keep our demo intact while your team finishes the compatibility change. We'll also hold off on any wide traffic switch until you give the green light.

Thanks again to you and Karthik for the quick turnaround. We'll share any follow-up logs if anything else shows up.

Best,
